input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text, /moves/bishop_c8.text, or /moves/queen_d8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
